exchange.sent: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a single direct source that ties AI data center technology changes to a required CMX500 / CMP180 configuration; the data center brochure lacks datasheet/test-condition evidence, and the R&S AI server mapping is not a formal configuration guide [3][89].
### Documented AI data center technology changes
| Change area | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Infrastructure scope broadens from compute alone to connectivity, power, resilience, power management, racks, management systems, cooling and service components [70]. |
| Full-spectrum data center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling and leak detection [2]. |
| High-speed electrical connectivity includes 224G/lane PAM4, 448G connector solutions, and OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T per cable assembly [61]. |
| Optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, co-packaged optics architecture and fiber deployment elements [63]. |
| AI server PCB changes include high layer count, larger area, high-speed transmission, low-Dk / low-loss / high-thermal materials, 30–40 layers and 12–14 aspect ratio process challenges [71]. |
### Documented measurement capability areas
| Measurement area | What capability is supported by the passages |
|---|---|
| PCB / high-speed digital measurement includes TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling and eye diagram analysis [77]. |
| AI server ecosystem mapping places R&S ZNA / ZNB in PCB IL and TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing and server motherboard high-speed trace testing contexts [85][87]. |
| Clock and noise measurement appears through R&S FSWP for LDO NSD, clock jitter and jitter / phase noise test contexts [18]. |
| CMX500 is a signaling/network emulation and measurement tester for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput and PER measurements [19]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling testing with CMX500 requires signaling mode, real-world conditions, RF TX/RX measurements, multiple RF chains for MLO, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E capabilities [25]. |
| The Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production source maps CMX500 to R&D signaling / interworking testing and CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing [26]. |
| CMP180 is a production / wireless communication device Radio Communication Tester with simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and multi-port RF generator/analyzer architecture [46][47]. |
| CMP180 option evidence links 6 GHz-plus frequency use to R&S CMP-K168, 320 MHz channel bandwidth to R&S CMP-K185 and True MIMO second connector bench to R&S CMP-K102 / R&S CMP-K105 [50]. |
| CMP180 specifications state 400 MHz to 6000 MHz basic RF generator/analyzer range, 6000 MHz to 8000 MHz with R&S CMP-K168, 250 MHz basic IF bandwidth and 500 MHz IF bandwidth with R&S CMP-K185 [53]. |
| Wi-Fi 8 signaling evidence says CMX500 implemented Wi-Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode before final IEEE ratification, and the Wi-Fi 8 source lists dRU and UEQM as new testing hurdles [28][33]. |
| Wi-Fi 8 evidence says its core PHY parameters continue up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO, while its focus shifts from sheer speed to ultra-high reliability [33]. |
| OTA cellular/WLAN evidence says CMX500 with EMITE chambers supports LTE, NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, NR FR2 up to 50 GHz, 5G RedCap and Wi-Fi 7 in an OTA environment [40]. |
| CMX500 FR2 evidence says CMX500 can use CMXHEAD30, CMXHEAD50 or CMXHEAD50-Evo remote radio heads for FR2, and the split concept optimizes radiated chamber test-environment link budget [90]. |
### Effect on Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability
【推論】If the AI data center change includes wireless devices, AP/CPE, OTA or cellular/WLAN connectivity around the data center, the signaling tester capability needs to cover multi-technology, multi-channel WLAN/cellular signaling, real-world RF TX/RX, MLO/multiple RF chains, OTA, FR1/FR2, RedCap and Wi-Fi 8 dRU/UEQM-style signaling tests [25][28][33][40][90].
【推論】For production non-signaling testing of such wireless functions, the supported capability direction is wider bandwidth, higher WLAN frequency coverage, simultaneous TX/RX, multi-port RF architecture and True MIMO connector-bench support, because CMP180 evidence names CMP-K185, CMP-K168, CMP-K102 and CMP-K105 in those contexts [47][50][53].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。

- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

- Easy to get in a call。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

- 測試展示使用 [[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device。
- 展示地點為 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 可 showcase physical layer features unique to [[Wi-Fi 8]]。
- 來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，以及 future-ready platform for cellular and non-cellular standards。

- 不可從本來源推論 [[Broadcom]] prototype device 的正式產品名稱、量產狀態、客戶、driver version、chipset SKU 或商用 availability。

- [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 目前由 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR 支撐，聚焦 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] over-the-air chamber workflow。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁已依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 記錄 WLAN signaling 802.11bn options 與 WLAN TX measurement option family；本新聞稿提供 PR / demonstration 層級的 [[Wi-Fi 8]] RF signaling tests 與 Broadcom prototype device 展示語境。

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 已指出量測範圍與 tolerance limits 不在 Features and Functions 文件內，需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**；本來源正是該 specifications 文件，補足 spec、general data 與 ordering information。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 提到 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 RF unit 分為 **R&S CMP-B802x** 與 **R&S CMP-B805x**，且 **R&S CMP-K185** 可啟用 500 MHz bandwidth；本來源以具體 ordering item **R&S CMP-B802I**、**R&S CMP-B805I**、**R&S CMP-K185** 補足 order number 與 availability 條件。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 提到未安裝 **R&S CMP-K168** 時 maximum 為 6 GHz；本來源在 ordering information 將 **R&S CMP-K168** 定義為 **Extended frequency range, from 6 GHz to 8 GHz**。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 列出多個 option order number 後綴為 `.xx`；本來源多數對應項目給出 `.02` 或 `.10` / `.11` 版本的完整 order number。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMW290]]、[[R&S CMW270]] 同屬 Rohde & Schwarz wireless / radio communication test 產品知識區，但 [[R&S CMP180]] 的本文件聚焦 production tester 類 RF generator/analyzer 規格與多埠 RF 測試。

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S CMP180]] **Radio Communication Tester** 的 specifications 文件，文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期標示 **March 2026**；封面與頁尾皆標示 **Version 08.00**。來源頁尾標示 **© 2021–2026 Rohde & Schwarz**，並聲明 **Data without tolerance limits is not binding**、**Subject to change**。

本規格書補足 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 所未提供的 binding specifications、base unit order number、RF unit order number、RF generator/analyzer 規格、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service 資訊。

主要重點：

- [[R&S CMP180]] base unit order no.：**1201.0002K18**，包含 power cables 與 getting started guide。
- 文件版次：**PD 3609.7348.22 | Version 08.00 | March 2026 (ch)**。
- RF generator/analyzer 頻率範圍：基本 **400 MHz to 6000 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K168** 可擴展到 **6000 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- 搭配 **R&S CMP-B805I** 與 **R&S CMP-K168** 時，generator overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8250 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8000 MHz**；analyzer overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8500 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8250 MHz**。
- 每個 RF generator/analyzer connector bench 有 **8 × SnapN** RF input/output to DUT；第二組 TRX / RF 2.1 to RF 2.8 需 **R&S CMP-K102** 或 **R&S CMP-K105** software license key。
- IF bandwidth：基本 **250 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K185** 可達 **500 MHz**，且 ordering information 明示 only available if **R&S CMP-B805I or higher option** is installed。
- ARB memory：**8 Gbyte/channel**；sample length up to **800 Msample**；maximum sample rate **312.5 MHz**，搭配 **R&S CMP-K185** 為 **625 MHz**。
- Calibration interval：**24 months**；base unit warranty：**1 year**。

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › 原文未解的問題

- 來源列出 **R&S CMP-PB18B**、**R&S CMP-PB18H**、**R&S CMP-B41H** 作為 interface / trigger 條件，但 ordering information 中列出的基本 assembly / interface 是 **R&S CMP-PB18I**、**R&S CMP-B40J**、**R&S CMP-B41J**；來源未說明 B/H/I/J variant 對應關係。
- **R&S CMP-KB805** 被稱為 Performance uprating for RF unit 500，且 WLAN EVM 圖表 / 規格列出 with **R&S CMP-KB805 option** 的 measured values；來源未在文字中完整解釋 KB805 的技術內容。
- 來源未提供 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 user manual 文件識別碼。
- 來源未展開 SnapN connector 的機械規格。
- 來源未提供 [[R&S CMPflexx system]] 的完整架構，只在 accessory 中列出 multi-instrument connection cable set。
- 來源未提供 R&S NRPx power sensors 的可支援型號清單。
- 來源頁首與頁尾皆為 Version 08.00 / March 2026，未見內部日期矛盾。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] frequency range up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說 Version 31.00 specifications 的最高 frequency option 為 44 GHz；新來源 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）在 RD site setup 仍列 [[R&S SMM100A]] as SG，卻在 appendix 以 [[R&S SMA100B]] 列出 8 kHz to 67 GHz。判斷：WoMT 方案材料中的 signal generator 型號 / 規格可能混用，正式頻率範圍須以產品 specifications 為準。

- Slide 3 說核心問題是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 原生運作於 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz，而 27 GHz、n257 / n258 屬 [[3GPP]] mmWave bands。
- Slide 3 說目前缺乏 Wi-Fi operating in mmWave bands 的 established global test standards。
- Slide 4 說 transmission principle 是透過 [[AiP]] modules 將 Wi-Fi 7 signals up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band。
- Slide 4 說 device types 包含 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP（Access Point）。
- Slide 8 提到 test basis 為 `Standard for Wi-Fi over mmWave (n257, n258)`。

依 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]：

- 來源未重新定義 WoMT，但在 Jio project RD and manufacturing setup 中明確分出 WIFI IB band 與 WIFI mmWave。

- [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 被放在 WIFI mmWave path。
- RD site 以 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSW67]]、[[R&S SMM100A]] 做 Tx / Rx measurement。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a single direct source that ties AI data center technology changes to a required CMX500 / CMP180 configuration; the data center brochure lacks datasheet/test-condition evidence, and the R&S AI server mapping is not a formal configuration guide [3][89].
### Documented AI data center technology changes
| Change area | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Infrastructure scope broadens from compute alone to connectivity, power, resilience, power management, racks, management systems, cooling and service components [70]. |
| Full-spectrum data center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling and leak detection [2]. |
| High-speed electrical connectivity includes 224G/lane PAM4, 448G connector solutions, and OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T per cable assembly [61]. |
| Optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, co-packaged optics architecture and fiber deployment elements [63]. |
| AI server PCB changes include high layer count, larger area, high-speed transmission, low-Dk / low-loss / high-thermal materials, 30–40 layers and 12–14 aspect ratio process challenges [71]. |
### Documented measurement capability areas
| Measurement area | What capability is supported by the passages |
|---|---|
| PCB / high-speed digital measurement includes TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling and eye diagram analysis [77]. |
| AI server ecosystem mapping places R&S ZNA / ZNB in PCB IL and TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing and server motherboard high-speed trace testing contexts [85][87]. |
| Clock and noise measurement appears through R&S FSWP for LDO NSD, clock jitter and jitter / phase noise test contexts [18]. |
| CMX500 is a signaling/network emulation and measurement tester for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput and PER measurements [19]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling testing with CMX500 requires signaling mode, real-world conditions, RF TX/RX measurements, multiple RF chains for MLO, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E capabilities [25]. |
| The Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production source maps CMX500 to R&D signaling / interworking testing and CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing [26]. |
| CMP180 is a production / wireless communication device Radio Communication Tester with simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and multi-port RF generator/analyzer architecture [46][47]. |
| CMP180 option evidence links 6 GHz-plus frequency use to R&S CMP-K168, 320 MHz channel bandwidth to R&S CMP-K185 and True MIMO second connector bench to R&S CMP-K102 / R&S CMP-K105 [50]. |
| CMP180 specifications state 400 MHz to 6000 MHz basic RF generator/analyzer range, 6000 MHz to 8000 MHz with R&S CMP-K168, 250 MHz basic IF bandwidth and 500 MHz IF bandwidth with R&S CMP-K185 [53]. |
| Wi-Fi 8 signaling evidence says CMX500 implemented Wi-Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode before final IEEE ratification, and the Wi-Fi 8 source lists dRU and UEQM as new testing hurdles [28][33]. |
| Wi-Fi 8 evidence says its core PHY parameters continue up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO, while its focus shifts from sheer speed to ultra-high reliability [33]. |
| OTA cellular/WLAN evidence says CMX500 with EMITE chambers supports LTE, NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, NR FR2 up to 50 GHz, 5G RedCap and Wi-Fi 7 in an OTA environment [40]. |
| CMX500 FR2 evidence says CMX500 can use CMXHEAD30, CMXHEAD50 or CMXHEAD50-Evo remote radio heads for FR2, and the split concept optimizes radiated chamber test-environment link budget [90]. |
### Effect on Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability
【推論】If the AI data center change includes wireless devices, AP/CPE, OTA or cellular/WLAN connectivity around the data center, the signaling tester capability needs to cover multi-technology, multi-channel WLAN/cellular signaling, real-world RF TX/RX, MLO/multiple RF chains, OTA, FR1/FR2, RedCap and Wi-Fi 8 dRU/UEQM-style signaling tests [25][28][33][40][90].
【推論】For production non-signaling testing of such wireless functions, the supported capability direction is wider bandwidth, higher WLAN frequency coverage, simultaneous TX/RX, multi-port RF architecture and True MIMO connector-bench support, because CMP180 evidence names CMP-K185, CMP-K168, CMP-K102 and CMP-K105 in those contexts [47][50][53].

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 來源中的測試架構
依 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]：

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

- 展示地點為 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S CMP180]] **Radio Communication Tester** 的 **CMP180 Features and Functions** 文件，文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，文件版本 **Version 09**，對應軟體版本 **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 **© 2026 Rohde & Schwarz**。

文件用途是提供 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 test applications overview；詳細描述需參考 **CMP180 help** 或 **user manuals**。量測範圍與 tolerance limits 不在本文件內，需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。文件聲明為：**Subject to change – data without tolerance limits is not binding.**

本文件涵蓋以下功能分類：

- Global options
- Bluetooth® options
- CDMA2000 options
- GSM options
- LP-IoT options
- LTE options
- NB-IoT options
- NR options
- Spectrum analysis options
- UWB options
- WCDMA options
- WLAN options
- R&S VSE options
- Ordering information

CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S CMP180]] 屬於 Rohde & Schwarz 的 radio communication tester 產品，與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSV3000]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 signal / spectrum analyzer 類產品不同；本來源主要是無線通訊標準 production / nonsignaling / TX/RX application option 清單與功能概述。
- 本來源是 **Features and Functions**，不是 specifications datasheet；因此所有量測範圍與 tolerance limits 必須回到 **PD 3609.7348.22** 查證。
- WLAN 部分明確把 6 GHz 以上 frequency 使用與 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 **R&S CMP-K168** 連結，320 MHz channel bandwidth 與 **R&S CMP-K185** 連結，True MIMO 第二 connector bench 與 **R&S CMP-K102** / **R&S CMP-K105** 連結。
- [[R&S VSE]] 部分指出 VSE client license 可以由 dongle 或 CMP180 提供；若由 CMP180 提供，需 **R&S CMP-KM150**。

CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 › 型號、硬體與 global options
文件指出 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 RF unit 有兩種 variant：

- **R&S CMP-B802x**：僅支援 **250 MHz bandwidth**。
- **R&S CMP-B805x**：支援 **250 MHz bandwidth**，可用 **R&S CMP-K185** 啟用 **500 MHz**。

Global options：

| Code | Name / 原文功能 | Order no. |
|---|---|---|
| R&S CMP-K102 | Enable 2nd TRX for RFU 250；搭配 R&S CMP-B802x 啟用第二個 connector bench | 1212.3543.xx |
| R&S CMP-K105 | Enable 2nd TRX for RFU 500；搭配 R&S CMP-B805x 啟用第二個 connector bench | 1212.3550.xx |
| R&S CMP-K168 | Extended frequency range；未安裝時 maximum 為 6 GHz；R&S CMP-B802B/H、-B805B/H 最高 8 GHz；R&S CMP-B802I、-B805I and higher 最高 8 GHz TX / 8.25 GHz RX | 1212.2582.xx |
| R&S CMP-K185 | Bandwidth 500 MHz；搭配 R&S CMP-B805x 將 bandwidth 提升至 500 MHz | 1212.3566.xx |
| R&S CMP-K108 | Smart channel；啟用 smart channel mode，將 instrument 分割為 channels | 1212.2099.xx |

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 已指出量測範圍與 tolerance limits 不在 Features and Functions 文件內，需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**；本來源正是該 specifications 文件，補足 spec、general data 與 ordering information。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 提到 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 RF unit 分為 **R&S CMP-B802x** 與 **R&S CMP-B805x**，且 **R&S CMP-K185** 可啟用 500 MHz bandwidth；本來源以具體 ordering item **R&S CMP-B802I**、**R&S CMP-B805I**、**R&S CMP-K185** 補足 order number 與 availability 條件。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 提到未安裝 **R&S CMP-K168** 時 maximum 為 6 GHz；本來源在 ordering information 將 **R&S CMP-K168** 定義為 **Extended frequency range, from 6 GHz to 8 GHz**。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 列出多個 option order number 後綴為 `.xx`；本來源多數對應項目給出 `.02` 或 `.10` / `.11` 版本的完整 order number。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMW290]]、[[R&S CMW270]] 同屬 Rohde & Schwarz wireless / radio communication test 產品知識區，但 [[R&S CMP180]] 的本文件聚焦 production tester 類 RF generator/analyzer 規格與多埠 RF 測試。

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S CMP180]] **Radio Communication Tester** 的 specifications 文件，文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期標示 **March 2026**；封面與頁尾皆標示 **Version 08.00**。來源頁尾標示 **© 2021–2026 Rohde & Schwarz**，並聲明 **Data without tolerance limits is not binding**、**Subject to change**。

本規格書補足 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 所未提供的 binding specifications、base unit order number、RF unit order number、RF generator/analyzer 規格、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service 資訊。

主要重點：

- [[R&S CMP180]] base unit order no.：**1201.0002K18**，包含 power cables 與 getting started guide。
- 文件版次：**PD 3609.7348.22 | Version 08.00 | March 2026 (ch)**。
- RF generator/analyzer 頻率範圍：基本 **400 MHz to 6000 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K168** 可擴展到 **6000 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- 搭配 **R&S CMP-B805I** 與 **R&S CMP-K168** 時，generator overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8250 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8000 MHz**；analyzer overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8500 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8250 MHz**。
- 每個 RF generator/analyzer connector bench 有 **8 × SnapN** RF input/output to DUT；第二組 TRX / RF 2.1 to RF 2.8 需 **R&S CMP-K102** 或 **R&S CMP-K105** software license key。
- IF bandwidth：基本 **250 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K185** 可達 **500 MHz**，且 ordering information 明示 only available if **R&S CMP-B805I or higher option** is installed。
- ARB memory：**8 Gbyte/channel**；sample length up to **800 Msample**；maximum sample rate **312.5 MHz**，搭配 **R&S CMP-K185** 為 **625 MHz**。
- Calibration interval：**24 months**；base unit warranty：**1 year**。

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源中的 RF generator / analyzer frequency range 表格 OCR 呈現方式不清，表格同時出現 **400 MHz to 8000 MHz** 與 requires **R&S CMP-K168** for **6000 MHz to 8000 MHz**；本頁依 ordering information 判讀為基本 6 GHz、K168 擴展到 8 GHz，但不自行推導更細的 SKU 行為。
- 來源列出 **R&S CMP-PB18B**、**R&S CMP-PB18H**、**R&S CMP-B41H** 作為 interface / trigger 條件，但 ordering information 中列出的基本 assembly / interface 是 **R&S CMP-PB18I**、**R&S CMP-B40J**、**R&S CMP-B41J**；來源未說明 B/H/I/J variant 對應關係。
- **R&S CMP-KB805** 被稱為 Performance uprating for RF unit 500，且 WLAN EVM 圖表 / 規格列出 with **R&S CMP-KB805 option** 的 measured values；來源未在文字中完整解釋 KB805 的技術內容。
- 來源未提供 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 user manual 文件識別碼。
- 來源未展開 SnapN connector 的機械規格。
- 來源未提供 [[R&S CMPflexx system]] 的完整架構，只在 accessory 中列出 multi-instrument connection cable set。
- 來源未提供 R&S NRPx power sensors 的可支援型號清單。
- 來源頁首與頁尾皆為 Version 08.00 / March 2026，未見內部日期矛盾。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 矛盾與口徑差異
⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] frequency range up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說 Version 31.00 specifications 的最高 frequency option 為 44 GHz；新來源 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）在 RD site setup 仍列 [[R&S SMM100A]] as SG，卻在 appendix 以 [[R&S SMA100B]] 列出 8 kHz to 67 GHz。判斷：WoMT 方案材料中的 signal generator 型號 / 規格可能混用，正式頻率範圍須以產品 specifications 為準。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 來源定義
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]]：

- WoMT project 的完整描述出現在 slide 1：`Technical Achievements and Measurement Results for JIO WoMT Project`。
- Slide 3 說核心問題是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 原生運作於 2.4 / 5 / 6 GHz，而 27 GHz、n257 / n258 屬 [[3GPP]] mmWave bands。
- Slide 3 說目前缺乏 Wi-Fi operating in mmWave bands 的 established global test standards。
- Slide 4 說 transmission principle 是透過 [[AiP]] modules 將 Wi-Fi 7 signals up-convert 到 27 GHz mmWave band。
- Slide 4 說 device types 包含 Integrated Radio CPEs 與 WoMT-AP（Access Point）。
- Slide 8 提到 test basis 為 `Standard for Wi-Fi over mmWave (n257, n258)`。

依 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]：

- 來源未重新定義 WoMT，但在 Jio project RD and manufacturing setup 中明確分出 WIFI IB band 與 WIFI mmWave。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被放在 WIFI IB band / native Wi-Fi testing path。
- [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 被放在 WIFI mmWave path。
- RD site 以 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSW67]]、[[R&S SMM100A]] 做 Tx / Rx measurement。

- [[Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology]] — 本來源未重新定義 WoMT，但方案配置明確連到 Jio project 的 Wi-Fi IB band 與 Wi-Fi mmWave 測試分工。
- [[R&S WoMT 測試方案]] — 本來源補充 full spec、RD + manufacturing site automation setup 與 RD site setup。
- [[JIO WiFi on mmWave 專案資料清單]] — 本來源是先前待讀的第二份簡報 `R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3.pptx`。
- [[OTA TX TEST]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、[[OOB spurious emissions]]、[[Occupied bandwidth]]、[[EIS]]、[[EVM]] — slide 7–15 出現的測試章節標題，但來源未提供數值或程序。
- [[WMT automation software]] — slide 4 標題中的 automation SW WMT 線索；來源未展開 WMT、版本、license 或是否等同既有 R&S WMT / wireless manufacturing test software。

- [[Jio]] — 來源題名與 agenda 中的專案客戶 / 專案名稱線索；本來源未補充完整法律名稱、採購狀態或部署狀態。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] / R&S — 本來源方案提供方，文件由 RSTW Sunny Wu 製作或標示。

- [[R&S CMQ200]] — full spec 與 CMP200 appendix 中列出的 production test 相關 chamber / shielding solution 線索。
- [[R&S AMS32]] — full spec setup 中列出的 automation / measurement software 線索；來源未提供版本、license 或配置細節。
- [[R&S CMP180]] — RD and manufacturing site setup 中負責 Wi-Fi IB band / native Wi-Fi testing 的 radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMP200]] — RD and manufacturing site setup 中與 [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 搭配，處理 Wi-Fi mmWave / FR2 相關測試。
- [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] — slide 4 中與 [[R&S CMP200]] 同列的 mmWave remote radio head。

R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3 › 重點摘要
- 來源正式日期未標示；Market 類主張只能追溯 raw converted 2026-09-17 與檔名字串 `202509_r3`。
- 簡報目的為整理 [[Jio]] project 的 R&S solution full spec、RD and manufacture site solution、RD site solution、ref. spec 與 appendix。
- Full spec setup（slide 3）列出 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S AMS32]]、manual setting、[[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S FSW67]] 與 final report。
- RD and manufacture site setup（slide 4）標題為 `R&S setup with automation SW WMT for JIO project RD and Manufacture site`，列出 [[R&S CMP180]]、DUT control、WIFI IB band、[[R&S CMPHEAD50]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、WIFI mmWave，表示此配置同時處理 Wi-Fi intermediate band / in-band 與 mmWave 測試流程。
- RD site setup（slide 5）列出 [[R&S FSW67]] signal analyzer、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、Tx measurement、[[R&S SMM100A]] signal generator 與 Rx measurement。
- Slide 7–15 只保留章節標題，包含 EVM capability typical values、OTA TX TEST、TRP、ACLR、OOB spurious emissions、occupied bandwidth 與 EIS at FR2；未提供可引用的數值、限值、測試條件或結果。
- Appendix slide 20 描述 [[R&S CMP180]]：frequency up to 8.5 GHz、bandwidth 500 MHz、two independent RF channels、2x8 RF ports、self-alignment、2 HU / 19 inch，並寫 `Can support wifi 7 with 2x SA/SG`。
- Appendix slide 21 列出 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援的主要 RF testing technologies：5G NR FR1 / RedCap / NTN、LTE-A、WCDMA、GSM、eMTC、NB-IoT / NTN、C-V2X、CDMA2000、IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/p、Bluetooth、Low Power IoT、802.15.4、LoRa、SigFox 與 GNSS 等；部分欄位空白或標示 `(-)`，需回查原圖。
- Appendix slide 22 描述 [[R&S CMP200]] 為 compact FR2 mmWave VSA / VSG，採 split concept：IF tester 4–20 GHz 與 mmWave remote radio head 24–44 GHz、1 GHz BW；並稱可整合 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 做 beam characterization / verification，整合 [[R&S CMQ200]] 做 production test。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Power 與 cooling connectivity
- [[Amphenol BarKlip I-O products]] / [[BarKlip Busbar Connectors]] — 來源稱其 distribute high-current power between busbars、cables and circuit boards，適用 power-dense data centers、OCP rack and power solutions。
- [[60 A Universal AC Input Connector and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet 2OU power distribution architecture standards，將 power 從 busway routing 到 power shelf。
- [[M-CRPS +54V Connectors and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet OCP M-CRPS power supply input specifications。
- [[PwrBlade ULTRA HD+ Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 Cable-to-Board serves as high-power I/O cable configuration in a low-profile design。
- [[OSFP-RHS 224G Cold Plate and Cage Assembly]] — 來源稱其 optimizes port thermal efficiency and reliability，meeting MSA requirements，並提供 one-step press assembly。
- [[Amphenol Liquid Cooling Leakage Detection Sensor Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 detects coolant leaks and ensures system reliability。
- [[Liquid Cooling Quick Disconnect Connectors]] — 來源稱其用於 high-efficiency thermal management。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Optical 與 fiber connectivity
- [[Amphenol XPO-LPO]] — 來源稱其以 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels，面向 AI scale-up deployments。
- [[1.6T OSFP Transceivers]] — 來源稱 Amphenol 200G/lane optical modules support DR4、FR4、2×DR4、2×FR4、AOC、breakout AOC configurations with LC or MPO ports。
- [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] — 來源稱 Amphenol offers an architecture from high-density electrical interposer to linear optical conversion module to fiber plant。
- [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]] — 來源稱其為 12-channel duplex optical transceiver，up to 25Gbps per channel，300Gbps cumulative on multi-mode fiber。
- [[300G CXP2 Active Optical Cable]] — 來源稱 CXP2 to CXP2 AOC provides cost-effective plug and play cabling solution，delivers high hardware faceplate port density among existing SFF industry standards。
- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a single direct source that ties AI data center technology changes to a required CMX500 / CMP180 configuration; the data center brochure lacks datasheet/test-condition evidence, and the R&S AI server mapping is not a formal configuration guide [3][89].
### Documented AI data center technology changes
| Change area | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Infrastructure scope broadens from compute alone to connectivity, power, resilience, power management, racks, management systems, cooling and service components [70]. |
| Full-spectrum data center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling and leak detection [2]. |
| High-speed electrical connectivity includes 224G/lane PAM4, 448G connector solutions, and OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T per cable assembly [61]. |
| Optical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, co-packaged optics architecture and fiber deployment elements [63]. |
| AI server PCB changes include high layer count, larger area, high-speed transmission, low-Dk / low-loss / high-thermal materials, 30–40 layers and 12–14 aspect ratio process challenges [71]. |
### Documented measurement capability areas
| Measurement area | What capability is supported by the passages |
|---|---|
| PCB / high-speed digital measurement includes TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, insertion loss, roughness, crosstalk, transmission-line modeling and eye diagram analysis [77]. |
| AI server ecosystem mapping places R&S ZNA / ZNB in PCB IL and TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing and server motherboard high-speed trace testing contexts [85][87]. |
| Clock and noise measurement appears through R&S FSWP for LDO NSD, clock jitter and jitter / phase noise test contexts [18]. |
| CMX500 is a signaling/network emulation and measurement tester for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, WLAN signaling, WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput and PER measurements [19]. |
| Wi-Fi 7 R&D signaling testing with CMX500 requires signaling mode, real-world conditions, RF TX/RX measurements, multiple RF chains for MLO, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E capabilities [25]. |
| The Wi-Fi 7 R&D / production source maps CMX500 to R&D signaling / interworking testing and CMP180 to production non-signaling RF testing [26]. |
| CMP180 is a production / wireless communication device Radio Communication Tester with simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing and multi-port RF generator/analyzer architecture [46][47]. |
| CMP180 option evidence links 6 GHz-plus frequency use to R&S CMP-K168, 320 MHz channel bandwidth to R&S CMP-K185 and True MIMO second connector bench to R&S CMP-K102 / R&S CMP-K105 [50]. |
| CMP180 specifications state 400 MHz to 6000 MHz basic RF generator/analyzer range, 6000 MHz to 8000 MHz with R&S CMP-K168, 250 MHz basic IF bandwidth and 500 MHz IF bandwidth with R&S CMP-K185 [53]. |
| Wi-Fi 8 signaling evidence says CMX500 implemented Wi-Fi 8 RF tests in signaling mode before final IEEE ratification, and the Wi-Fi 8 source lists dRU and UEQM as new testing hurdles [28][33]. |
| Wi-Fi 8 evidence says its core PHY parameters continue up to 7.125 GHz, channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO, while its focus shifts from sheer speed to ultra-high reliability [33]. |
| OTA cellular/WLAN evidence says CMX500 with EMITE chambers supports LTE, NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, NR FR2 up to 50 GHz, 5G RedCap and Wi-Fi 7 in an OTA environment [40]. |
| CMX500 FR2 evidence says CMX500 can use CMXHEAD30, CMXHEAD50 or CMXHEAD50-Evo remote radio heads for FR2, and the split concept optimizes radiated chamber test-environment link budget [90]. |
### Effect on Signaling / Non-signaling Tester capability
【推論】If the AI data center change includes wireless devices, AP/CPE, OTA or cellular/WLAN connectivity around the data center, the signaling tester capability needs to cover multi-technology, multi-channel WLAN/cellular signaling, real-world RF TX/RX, MLO/multiple RF chains, OTA, FR1/FR2, RedCap and Wi-Fi 8 dRU/UEQM-style signaling tests [25][28][33][40][90].
【推論】For production non-signaling testing of such wireless functions, the supported capability direction is wider bandwidth, higher WLAN frequency coverage, simultaneous TX/RX, multi-port RF architecture and True MIMO connector-bench support, because CMP180 evidence names CMP-K185, CMP-K168, CMP-K102 and CMP-K105 in those contexts [47][50][53].

CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S CMP180]] 屬於 Rohde & Schwarz 的 radio communication tester 產品，與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSV3000]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 signal / spectrum analyzer 類產品不同；本來源主要是無線通訊標準 production / nonsignaling / TX/RX application option 清單與功能概述。
- 本來源是 **Features and Functions**，不是 specifications datasheet；因此所有量測範圍與 tolerance limits 必須回到 **PD 3609.7348.22** 查證。
- WLAN 部分明確把 6 GHz 以上 frequency 使用與 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 **R&S CMP-K168** 連結，320 MHz channel bandwidth 與 **R&S CMP-K185** 連結，True MIMO 第二 connector bench 與 **R&S CMP-K102** / **R&S CMP-K105** 連結。
- [[R&S VSE]] 部分指出 VSE client license 可以由 dongle 或 CMP180 提供；若由 CMP180 提供，需 **R&S CMP-KM150**。

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S CMP180]] **Radio Communication Tester** 的 specifications 文件，文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期標示 **March 2026**；封面與頁尾皆標示 **Version 08.00**。來源頁尾標示 **© 2021–2026 Rohde & Schwarz**，並聲明 **Data without tolerance limits is not binding**、**Subject to change**。

本規格書補足 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 所未提供的 binding specifications、base unit order number、RF unit order number、RF generator/analyzer 規格、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service 資訊。

主要重點：

- [[R&S CMP180]] base unit order no.：**1201.0002K18**，包含 power cables 與 getting started guide。
- 文件版次：**PD 3609.7348.22 | Version 08.00 | March 2026 (ch)**。
- RF generator/analyzer 頻率範圍：基本 **400 MHz to 6000 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K168** 可擴展到 **6000 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- 搭配 **R&S CMP-B805I** 與 **R&S CMP-K168** 時，generator overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8250 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8000 MHz**；analyzer overrange 為 **6000 MHz to 8500 MHz**，maximum center frequency **8250 MHz**。
- 每個 RF generator/analyzer connector bench 有 **8 × SnapN** RF input/output to DUT；第二組 TRX / RF 2.1 to RF 2.8 需 **R&S CMP-K102** 或 **R&S CMP-K105** software license key。
- IF bandwidth：基本 **250 MHz**；使用 **R&S CMP-K185** 可達 **500 MHz**，且 ordering information 明示 only available if **R&S CMP-B805I or higher option** is installed。
- ARB memory：**8 Gbyte/channel**；sample length up to **800 Msample**；maximum sample rate **312.5 MHz**，搭配 **R&S CMP-K185** 為 **625 MHz**。
- Calibration interval：**24 months**；base unit warranty：**1 year**。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Optical 與 fiber connectivity
- [[Amphenol XPO-LPO]] — 來源稱其以 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels，面向 AI scale-up deployments。
- [[1.6T OSFP Transceivers]] — 來源稱 Amphenol 200G/lane optical modules support DR4、FR4、2×DR4、2×FR4、AOC、breakout AOC configurations with LC or MPO ports。
- [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] — 來源稱 Amphenol offers an architecture from high-density electrical interposer to linear optical conversion module to fiber plant。
- [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]] — 來源稱其為 12-channel duplex optical transceiver，up to 25Gbps per channel，300Gbps cumulative on multi-mode fiber。
- [[300G CXP2 Active Optical Cable]] — 來源稱 CXP2 to CXP2 AOC provides cost-effective plug and play cabling solution，delivers high hardware faceplate port density among existing SFF industry standards。
- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。
